steps.instruction: Spread 1 pound of raw pre-shelled peanuts on a large baking sheet.
Roast the peanuts in the oven at 350 °F for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Roast the peanuts in the oven at 350 °F for 10 to twelve minutes.

steps.instruction: While the peanuts are hot, wrap a few handfuls in a dish towel.
Roll the peanuts against each other in the towel to rub off the skins.
steps.spoken: Roll the peanuts against each other in the towel for several seconds to rub off the skins. Do this while they are still hot.

steps.instruction: Put the skinned peanuts in a food processor, with salt if you like.
Chop until the peanut butter is as thick as you like.
steps.spoken: Chop the peanuts until the peanut butter is as thick as you like. This may take a few minutes.
